chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The wealth that teaches you a lesson does not go to waste.

key_terms.وَعَظَكَ: taught you a lesson / admonished you

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about wealth that teaches a lesson?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) asserts that wealth is only truly lost if it fails to provide wisdom or moral admonition, framing material possession as a test of spiritual awareness. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *hikmah* (wisdom) as the ultimate metric of value, where assets serve as instruments for self-reflection and divine remembrance rather than mere accumulation.
